mapper.sql: id, account_id, collection_run_id, platform_type, balance, frozen_balance, total_requests, total_tokens, total_cost, total_actual_cost, metrics, platform_stats, raw_data, collected_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_usage_dashboard_snapshots ( account_id, collection_run_id, platform_type, balance, frozen_balance, total_requests, total_tokens, total_cost, total_actual_cost, metrics, platform_stats, raw_data, collected_at ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{collectionRunId}, #{platformType}, #{balance}, #{frozenBalance}, #{totalRequests}, #{totalTokens}, #{totalCost}, #{totalActualCost}, #{metrics,typeHandler=com.monitor.platform.infrastructure.mybatis.handler.JsonbStringTypeHandler}, #{platformStats,typeHandler=com.monitor.platform.infrastructure.mybatis.handler.JsonbStringTypeHandler}, #{rawData,typeHandler=com.monitor.platform.infrastructure.mybatis.handler.JsonbStringTypeHandler}, #{collectedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM account_usage_dashboard_snapshots WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY collected_at DESC LIMIT 1
